concepts.caption: First snow hit. She had to dance
concepts.title: First Snow Fell and Her Paws Couldn't Stay Still ❄️🐱
concepts.en_line: The first snowflakes fell and she simply had to dance about it.

shots.image: Photorealistic full-body shot of a slim, elegant Havana Brown cat with a short glossy solid rich chocolate-brown coat, a long narrow muzzle, large forward-tilted ears, brown whiskers and bright vivid green eyes, standing upright on its hind legs in the middle of a small snow-covered backyard garden, both front paws raised at chest height mid-dance, big soft snowflakes falling all around, fresh white snow on the ground, a few small snow-dusted pine shrubs and a wooden fence softly blurred behind, soft bright winter daylight, the whole cat clearly visible against the white snow, vertical composition
shots.motion: From the very first frame the chocolate-brown Havana Brown cat is already dancing on its hind legs, pumping both front paws up and down to the beat, swaying its hips side to side and bobbing its head with each beat, green eyes bright and happy, mouth closed. Big soft snowflakes keep falling around it. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same slim Havana Brown cat with the same fur pattern, face and eye color: short glossy solid chocolate-brown coat, large forward-tilted ears and bright vivid green eyes. Same snowy backyard garden and same falling snow. Now the cat strikes its final pose, still standing on its hind legs with both front paws stretched high above its head, chin lifted toward the falling snow, eyes half-closed in joy, mouth closed, a few white snowflakes resting on its head and shoulders. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: From the very first frame the Havana Brown cat holds both front paws high in the air and sways side to side to the beat with small hops in place, then blinks happily as a snowflake lands on its nose and gives a tiny head shake. Snowflakes keep drifting down all around. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

trend.why_now: Seoul's first snow came on November 8, 12 days earlier than average, and first-snow posts are everywhere. In November 2026 AI cat dance clips are trending, with cats springing up and pumping their paws to a beat.
trend.pattern: AI cat dance hook: the cat is already on its hind legs pumping its paws from the first second, then ends with both paws in the air. The relatable beat is the first-snow excitement everyone feels.
